ChongCyrus/Vibe-Mathematics.body:
# Vibe Mathematics — Multi-Agent Math Problem Solving and Verification Framework (Four Architectures)

[English](https://github.com/ChongCyrus/Vibe-Mathematics/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) | Chinese

> A set of **agent presets** (`vibe-math-v2` / `vibe-math-v3` / `vibe-math-v4` / `vibe-math-v5`) running inside the **DeepSeek Harness**. They use multi-agent collaboration to solve math problems automatically and cross-verify conclusions with multiple agents. All four presets share the same foundation: **resumable runs**, **mid-run human intervention**, **progress reporting**, and **natural-language control**, but they use four generations of different solving architectures.
> **💡 v4/v5 first**: `vibe-math-v4` (the “resident self-organizing collaborative research” architecture) and `vibe-math-v5` (the latest “research institute system”) are the **current main maintenance direction**. `vibe-math-v2` and `vibe-math-v3` are **classic/early architectures** that have **matured and been finalized**, and going forward they receive only **compatibility maintenance** (new features go only into v4/v5). All four are bundled in the package and work normally. See [`docs/maintenance-policy.md`](https://github.com/ChongCyrus/Vibe-Mathematics/blob/HEAD/docs/maintenance-policy.md) for details. Choose based on your actual needs (see “How to choose” below).
>
> - **`vibe-math-v2` (probability-driven · JSON data layer) · classic**: `qs.json` problem list + `Propos/` proposition library + probability-driven scheduling + code-heuristic scheduling;
> - **`vibe-math-v3` (third generation · paper-style md + planning agent + method library) · classic**: all knowledge is stored and continued as **Markdown paper/research-report style** (`Problems/` problem list with dependencies and source motivation, `Progress/` research log, `Propos/` proposition library, `Methods/` general theory invention library, `Verified/` absolutely trusted). Before scheduling, a **planning agent** autonomously drafts a plan for the next N steps. Theories, frameworks, tools, methods, and ideas invented during problem solving are consolidated by the **Method Keeper** into a reusable method system (as when group theory or functional analysis is invented);
> - **`vibe-math-v4` (fourth generation · resident self-organizing collaborative research) 🧪 experimental**: a group of **persistent resident sub-agents** that **leave messages for each other and hold meetings**, autonomously deciding all task arrangements (no central scheduler). Each maintains its own progress, proposition, method, and subproblem libraries and consults the others. Verification is written **only when all residents agree (true or false)**…

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

# aur-packages

> Arch Linux AUR package maintenance monorepo: package metadata service + automatic update tool + PKGBUILD repository

This repository is a uv workspace monorepo containing two Python applications and AUR package assets:

| Project | Description |
| ---- | ---- |
| [`projects/aur-metadata`](https://github.com/awsl1414/aur-packages/blob/HEAD/projects/aur-metadata/) | Package metadata service: periodically tracks upstream versions, computes file hashes (b2/sha256/sha512), and serves them via HTTP API for the update tool to query |
| [`projects/aur-auto-update`](https://github.com/awsl1414/aur-packages/blob/HEAD/projects/aur-auto-update/) | AUR package auto-update tool: consumes the aur-metadata API and automatically updates the version numbers and checksums of PKGBUILDs under `packages/` |
| `packages/` | AUR PKGBUILDs and local source files (automatically published to AUR by CI after version updates) |

## Quick Start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/awsl1414/aur-packages.git
cd aur-packages

# Install system dependencies (fallback downloader for aur-auto-update)
sudo pacman -S aria2   # or sudo apt install aria2

# Sync dependencies (uv workspace, single uv.lock manages all members)
uv sync

# Update all packages (run from repo root; use -p <name> to specify a package, --list to show available packages)
uv run --package aur-auto-update aur-auto-update

# Start the metadata service (run from repo root or member directory, default :8000)
uv run --package aur-metadata aur-metadata
```

After the service starts, visit `http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs` to view the interactive API documentation.

c1201y/ClassSoftwareHub.body:
# ClassSoftwareHub

**Commonly Used Software Download Site for Audio-Visual Education Committee Members (Vue Source Edition)**

ClassSoftwareHub is a software download site for audio-visual education committee members, built with **Vue 3 + Vite + TypeScript**. It uses the [WinUIonWeb](https://github.com/Furry-Xiyi/WinUIonWeb) component library to provide a WinUI-style interface. This site was reverse-engineered from the single file `indexV20260831.html`, splitting the previously compressed page core into a readable, maintainable project.

## Features

- **Software downloads**: Displays commonly used software by category. Supports viewing details, system restrictions, version numbers, file sizes, and checksums, and provides direct file download links.
- **Site-wide search**: Press `Ctrl + K` (or `Ctrl + F`) to open the search panel, which searches software, built-in tools, AI navigation sites, and pages in one go.
- **AI navigation**: Built-in navigation for common AI websites for quick access.
- **Welcome dialog**: On first visit, shows a WinUI-style welcome window with links to the repository, the author's homepage, related articles, the QQ group, and sponsoring the author.
- **Data fault tolerance**: A malformed software JSON file does not affect the rest of the site. A red banner at the top of the page identifies the faulty file and the reason.
- **Automatic update checks**: A built-in script periodically verifies software versions, direct download links, and file sizes. It can write changes back automatically or open an Issue for manual confirmation.
- **Submit software**: You can submit software you find useful to help make ClassSoftwareHub better!

## Getting Started

### Online Access

The site is deployed and can be accessed directly:

- [ClassSoftwareHub](https://github.com/c1201y/ClassSoftwareHub/blob/HEAD/classsoftwarehub.us.ci)

- [Mirror site](https://github.com/c1201y/ClassSoftwareHub/blob/HEAD/classsoftwarehub.132614.xyz) This mirror is faster, meow

### Running Locally

```bash
npm install          # First-time setup
npm run dev          # Dev preview http://localhost:5173
npm run build        # Standard build → dist/
npm run build:single # Single-file build → dist/index.html (about 2MB, can be opened offline by double-clicking)
npm run type-check   # TypeScript type checking
```

Full instructions are in the maintenance manual.

chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor.description: Hong Kong Immigration Department smart ID card booking quota monitoring dashboard: detection every 5 minutes, plus email/Feishu notifications when slots are released (third-party tool, not official)
chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor.body:
# Hong Kong ID Card Booking Quota Dashboard

Monitors smart ID card booking quotas at the six Registration of Persons Offices of the Hong Kong Immigration Department, checking about every 2 minutes, and reminds subscribers via email / Feishu group when slots are released. **A third-party public-interest tool, not an official service of the Immigration Department. It only monitors and sends reminders; it does not do any proxy grabbing or booking.**

## Dashboard entry

- **Preferred (stable direct access from mainland China):** https://hkid-quota-monitor.pages.dev/
- Backup: https://chen1111-a.github.io/hkid-quota-monitor/
  (From mainland networks, github.io is intermittently unreachable. jsDelivr/raw direct links carry a nosniff header and will only display source code, so do not use them as web entry points.)
- The full experience in mainland China without a VPN is **email subscription + Feishu group**. The notification pipeline is entirely direct domestic access, pushing slot releases to your phone the moment they happen. The dashboard is only a supplement.

## How it works

```
cron-job.org (every 2 minutes) ──▶ GitHub Actions
                            │  python -m quota_monitor.run
                            │  ├─ fetch Immigration Department public quota API (read-only, one request per run)
                            │  ├─ diff against previous snapshot → slot-release events
                            │  └─ commit data/ + refresh jsDelivr cache
                            ▼
        index.html dashboard (mobile-first, auto-refreshes every 90 seconds)
        Email + Feishu notifications (triggered by slot-release events, with debounce cooldown)
```

- API structure: [docs/api-notes.md](https://github.com/chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/api-notes.md)
- 2-minute trigger configuration: [docs/cron-setup.md](https://github.com/chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/cron-setup.md)

## Improvements over similar tools

- **Mobile-first:** dates scroll vertically in rows, so all 6 offices fit on one screen without horizontal table scrolling
- **Colorblind-friendly:** status cells use both color and text (available / few / full)
- **Anti-notification flooding:** the official API has load-balancing data jitter (measured fluctuation of 304↔346 cells within the same minute). The notification layer has a per-cell cooldown, so it does not blast a notification every round
- **Direct mainland access:** the email subscription and Feishu notification pipelines are direct domestic links, with no circumvention needed
- Light and dark themes; summary cards directly answer "earliest date available to book"

fuqiuluo/amice.body:
# Amice

[English](https://github.com/fuqiuluo/amice/blob/HEAD/README_en_US.md) | Simplified Chinese

Amice is a code obfuscation tool that works as an LLVM Pass plugin, providing string encryption, control-flow obfuscation, and instruction-level VMP virtualization for C/C++, Rust, and Android native code. After downloading a prebuilt plugin, a single `-fpass-plugin` argument plugs it into an existing build. There is no need to recompile LLVM, and no need to modify the compiler or project source.

> **Status**: currently beta (v0.1.5-beta.5). Configuration options and behavior may change between versions. Prebuilt plugins cover LLVM/Clang 18–23 on Linux/macOS, and Android NDK r27d–r30 (r29/r30 provide a full bundle including the NDK and runtime libraries; r27d/r28c provide the plugin only). There are no prebuilt packages for Windows yet; you can [build from source](https://github.com/fuqiuluo/amice/blob/HEAD/docs/LLVMSetup_zh_CN.md).

## Features

- **Plug and play** — loaded into clang as a dynamic library, no LLVM rebuild needed; existing Clang projects only need one compiler flag to integrate
- **String encryption** — `xor` / `simd_xor` algorithms, supporting lazy decryption and decryption at program startup, plus stack/heap allocation
- **Control-flow obfuscation** — control-flow flattening, VM control-flow flattening, [BCF](https://github.com/fuqiuluo/amice/blob/HEAD/docs/EnvConfig_zh_CN.md#虚假控制流混淆), indirect calls/jumps, basic block splitting and reordering, and more
- **Instruction-level VMP** — lifts functions into VM bytecode and generates an interpreting runtime
- **MBA obfuscation** — mixed Boolean-arithmetic rewriting, covering integer and binary64 floating-point regions
- **Per-function control** — select obfuscation strategies per function via `__attribute__((annotate(...)))`
- **Multi-language integration** — C/C++, Rust (nightly `-Zllvm-plugins`), Android NDK (CMake/Gradle bundle)
- **Composable** — all toggles, parameters, and Pass execution order are configurable via environment variables or `amice.toml`

For the full Pass support matrix (language coverage × environment variable switches), see [runtime environment variables](https://github.com/fuqiuluo/amice/blob/HEAD/docs/EnvConfig_zh_CN.md).

# Clash Node Optimization

`聚合配置.yaml` is the input for the original subscription source and split-routing rules. `节点来源.yaml` is the newly added list of public free sources. `优选配置.yaml` is the complete configuration produced by automatic filtering and can be imported directly. It is intended for Clash Meta / Mihomo clients.

## Usage

Add the remote configuration in your client:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoooou/my_yml/main/%E4%BC%98%E9%80%89%E9%85%8D%E7%BD%AE.yaml
```

Set the client's remote configuration refresh interval to 24 hours. After GitHub updates the file, the client still needs to refresh before it loads the new nodes.

Phones keep **5 groups**. By default, use “⭐ 综合优选” under “🚀 全局选择”. If you need Taiwan or Singapore, switch to “🌏 台湾／新加坡”. Refreshing the original subscription makes the change take effect.

| Group | Purpose |
|---|---|
| 🚀 全局选择 | Chooses which type of node is in use; defaults to 综合优选 |
| ⭐ 综合优选 | Fully passes a 1 MB download and meets the quality threshold for overseas responses across three rounds. Sorted by website response time and stability; does not fall back to failed nodes |
| ⚡ 高速下载 | From the comprehensive qualified pool, nodes that fully download 50 MB within 20 seconds, sorted by speed in this test |
| 🏠 非机房 IP | From the comprehensive qualified pool, independent exits that are clearly not datacenter IPs, deduplicated by exit IP |
| 🌏 台湾／新加坡 | Exits confirmed in TW/SG. Keeps the required access and download conditions, allows slower web responses, and has no quantity limit |

综合、高速 and 非机房 share a strict node pool: domestic TCP clearly passes, a 1 MB download fully passes, and overseas website responses qualify. The 台湾／新加坡 group uses separate regional thresholds. Nodes that meet only the regional thresholds are placed only in the regional group, not in the other node groups. Nodes that fail to meet any admission threshold do not have their definitions or credentials written to the subscription; their test results are kept only in the report. All sources are fetched again every day, and recovered nodes can be admitted again. Hong Kong is limited to 30 nodes in total; other regions have no limit. Quantity policy does not reduce the testing of any node. For the filtering basis, current thresholds, and future recommendations, see [面向中国移动的筛选方案](https://github.com/hoooou/my_yml/blob/HEAD/docs/node-selection-plan.md).

Regional groups still require **204 three rounds, domestic TCP, access to the 12 specified overseas web pages with three rounds each, a single round of Claude trace, and a complete 1 MB download**, and there must be no detected contradiction between exit region and IP. The median Google/YouTube response time is relaxed to **3 seconds**, the slowest round to **5 seconds**, and the range to **3 seconds**. The 12 specified pages and the Claude trace must all pass. Other traces cannot replace the 12 sites. 403 responses, CAPTCHAs, slow-response statuses, failures, or untested nodes are not allowed through. Regions are not guessed from node names. The 50 MB test is not a condition for admission to regional groups. If no node qualifies, `REJECT` is shown and failed nodes are not added. A daily observation dashboard for the 2026 iThome Ironman Contest. It is a static site: GitHub Actions scrapes the data on a schedule, and Cloudflare Pages hosts it for free.

proteus-vue/proteus.body:
# Proteus (普罗透斯): A Semantically Converged Cross-Platform Application Framework

> **One semantic model. Any render engine. Zero native glue.**
> One semantic kernel, any rendering engine, any native capability. Business code only talks to the semantic layer. The render substrate, compiler, host container, and execution carrier are all pluggable.
>
> **Not cross-platform translation, but a cross-platform operating system: semantics are the kernel, backends are drivers.**

[Methodology Philosophy](#方法论哲学统一语义收敛) · [Killer Features](#杀手特性) · [Quick Start](https://github.com/proteus-vue/proteus/blob/HEAD/docs/getting-started.md) · [Architecture Overview](https://github.com/proteus-vue/proteus/blob/HEAD/docs/board-inventory.md) · [Positioning](https://github.com/proteus-vue/proteus/blob/HEAD/docs/proteus-positioning-v3.md)

---

## Why Proteus (Origin of the Name)

**Proteus (普罗透斯)** is a sea god of ancient Greek mythology, a herdsman of Poseidon, called the "Old Man of the Sea." In the *Odyssey*, when he is captured on the island of Pharos, he transforms into a lion, a serpent, a boar, flowing water, and a tree. The English word **protean (ever-changing)** derives from his name. He also knows the past, the present, and the future.

| Proteus's divine attribute | The framework's differentiating advantage |
|---|---|
| **Metamorphosis**: one entity takes many forms | **One semantics, many platform forms**: the same business semantics → Vue DOM / native / Flutter / Skia / mini programs. The form changes, the essence does not |
| **Prophecy**: foresees the future | **Compile-time first**: the semantic IR is validated and converged at build time. Anything detectable at compile time is never left until runtime |
| **Constant essence**: after transforming, the entity is still Proteus | **Constant semantics**: business code depends only on the semantic kernel. All platform differences are pushed down into backend implementation details |
| **Knows all things**: knows past, present, and future | **Verifiable**: every SPI layer has a conformance gate. Whether a backend implementation complies is machine-checkable and enforced by CI |
| **Incarnate as light**: transformation is manifestation, nothing can hide | **Transparent compilation**: conversion rules are self-describing (an AI manual), and decision traces can be enumerated and traced back. No black boxes |

## Methodology: Unified Semantic Convergence

> **Proteus does not do cross-platform translation. It defines a platform-independent semantic kernel, and all platform differences are pushed down into "backend implementation details."**

Core formula:

```
Any cross-platform problem = semantic definition (done by the framework) + backend implementation (done by the platform)

# WECHATAUTO.SDK - A Modern AI-Oriented WeChat RPA Automation Framework

WeChatAuto.SDK is an AI-oriented WeChat RPA automation SDK built on .NET and UI automation technology. It is designed for scenarios that integrate artificial intelligence, such as LLM context interaction. The SDK provides a rich, intuitive API, supports modern .NET features such as dependency injection, and also offers an official Python SDK, so you can easily integrate WeChat automation workflows into existing systems.

## ✨ Features

- 💬 **Comprehensive messaging and social capabilities** - Supports sending text, emoji, files, @mentions, message forwarding, group management, Moments operations, and contact management, and provides common capabilities such as message listening; all important interfaces are covered by unit tests.
  
- 🛡️ **Lower risk-control risk** - Supports pure software automation as well as solutions combined with hardware keyboard and mouse simulators, so you can choose a more robust execution method based on business needs and security levels.

- 🚀 **Multi-instance and distributed support** - Can manage multiple WeChat clients at the same time. It can be used as a local SDK, or through a WebSocket long connection, so one application can control multiple WeChat instances on multiple machines, or multiple applications can control the same WeChat instance.

- 🔧 **WeChat version compatibility** - Compatible with older (e.g., 3.9.12.xx) and newer (e.g., 4.1.11.xx) WeChat versions, and continuously updated to adapt to new client releases.

- 🧩 **Multi-language support** - Natively developed in .NET, and also provides an official Python SDK for easy integration across different language ecosystems.

- 🔌 **Easy integration and high reliability** - Supports dependency injection, is a lightweight SDK that is easy to embed into existing systems, and uses industrial-grade thread management and stability design to reduce the risk of UI automation freezing.

- 🤖 **AI-friendly** - Natively supports LLM context integration and includes a built-in MCP Server, making it easy to connect with mainstream agents and platforms and helping intelligent applications close the loop on WeChat automation/RPA and extend it.
